name: /record Telegram command — record manual post inline without SSH
block: Phase 1.5 gate ops — manual posting workflow
goal: Add /record <video_id> <views> [title] command to Telegram bot. Owner-only. Appends entry to workspace/scs001/manual-posts.jsonl (same format as record-manual-post.ts). Returns confirmation + gate progress (posts/views/days to Apr 7). Completes the full Telegram posting loop: /review → post on TikTok → /record → /post-reminder.
rationale: Apr 7 gate: 0/30 posts, ~22 days. /review (Sprint 142) shows what to post. But recording a post still requires SSH + CLI. /record eliminates the SSH step. Operator can now complete the full workflow from Telegram. Sprint 143 = last blocker for friction-free daily posting.
swarm: NOT USED — 2 file edits + 1 validation script. Direct write.

tasks.title: commands.ts — handleRecord() + update handleHelp()
tasks.description: Add handleRecord(chatId, ownerChatId, text): owner-only. Parse text: '/record <video_id> <views> [title...]'. video_id = args[1], views = parseInt(args[2]), title = args.slice(3).join(' ') or undefined. Validate: if no video_id → show usage. If views is NaN → show usage. Append JSON line to workspace/scs001/manual-posts.jsonl: { video_id, views, title?, posted_at: ISO, recorded_at: ISO }. Create dir if not exists. After write: load all posts, compute totalPosts/totalViews/daysToGate/cadence. Send confirmation message: '✅ Recorded: <video_id> — <views> views' + gate progress block (Posts: X/30, Views: Y/500, Cadence: Z/day, Days: N). Add '/record <id> <views> [title] — Record posted video (owner)' to handleHelp() under TikTok Pipeline section.

tasks.title: index.ts — route /record to handleRecord()
tasks.description: Import handleRecord from ./commands. Add case '/record': await handleRecord(chatId, OWNER_CHAT_ID, text); in dispatch switch after /review case.

tasks.title: scripts/scs001/validate-sprint-143.ts — validation script
tasks.description: 6 checks: (1) commands.ts exports handleRecord; (2) handleRecord is owner-gated; (3) handleRecord writes to manual-posts.jsonl; (4) handleHelp lists /record; (5) index.ts imports handleRecord; (6) index.ts routes '/record'. Exit 0 on all pass.

acceptance_criteria: /record is owner-gated — non-owner gets '🔒 Owner only.'
/record <id> <views> appends entry to manual-posts.jsonl with correct format
handleHelp lists /record under TikTok Pipeline section
